messages:
lina (Marketing): Quick sync — APAC webinar confirmed for Apr 12 9:00 JST. Need a compact promo bundle and an inbound routing diagram for SDRs. Low-touch but polished.

sam (Design): I can handle the bundle. What sizes/assets are required?

lina (Marketing): Hero (1200x628), 3 social squares (1080x1080), one story vertical (1080x1920), email header (600x200), one-page claim graphic for landing, and an editable routing SVG. Also need speaker headshots cropped.

harper (Growth): For routing: landing -> form -> qualification rules -> assign to AE / Growth nurture / Enterprise SDR. Add a replay-only path to nurture. Need explicit UTMs and who owns follow-up.

sam (Design): Got it. I'll use the brand tokens and icon kit. No gradients, keep CTA in brand-accent-2. Also can do two visual variants: one with bold stat callout and one with softer benefit line.

mike (Brand): Stat callouts need source attribution. Avoid direct competitor comparisons or absolute guarantees. Use "lower per-token serving cost" unless legal clears a percentage. Keep type scales consistent with the design system.

lina (Marketing): We want two copy variants for A/B: A = "Reduce inference spend" B = "Lower per-request cost". Harper — which is better for tracking?

harper (Growth): Both good. We'll map Variant A to utm_campaign=apac_webinar_A and Variant B to apac_webinar_B. Add UTMs to all social links. Tae will handle JP/KR localization.

tae (Localization): I can localize but need the final English strings by Apr 4 to turn around JP/KR by Apr 8. Tagging native reviewers for each locale.

sam (Design): Figma starter: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/apac-webinar-pack — frames prefixed "APR12_PROMO". Export rules: PNG for socials, SVG for diagram (editable layers). Include small code snippet for UTMs on the diagram.

sam (Design): UTM example to include in legend: ```?utm_source=organic_social&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=apac_webinar_A```

legal-bot: Numeric claims require the benchmark CSV + run-date for approval. Qualitative claims ok for now. No absolute promises (e.g., "save money guaranteed"). Include a link to the benchmark doc if using numbers.

mike (Brand): Also make sure contrast meets AA (4.5:1) for body text and buttons meet accessible tap target sizes.

sam (Design): Timeline: first pass Apr 2, review Apr 3-4, localization overlays Apr 5-7, final export Apr 8 AM. If copy slips we can ship hero text-agnostic and overlay translations later.

lina (Marketing): Sounds good. Harper — can you own UTM mapping sheet and who owns each lead?

harper (Growth): Yep — I'll post a Google sheet and assign Growth / AE / Enterprise owners. Target: Apr 3.

lina (Marketing): Thanks team. Sam — once first pass is up, drop the Figma link and a quick checklist (assets + filenames + export settings). :thumbsup:

sam (Design): Will do. Figma frames commented and I'll ping when ready.
